Application Materials.content:
**Applicants should scan and submit the following documents to the Online Application System for evaluation of their applications:**
- Identity documents (e.g. Identity card*, passport or other travel document)
- Official Transcript (for academic qualifications of undergraduate and/or postgraduate studies):
- An official final transcript for a completed programme
- The latest transcript if the programme is not yet completed
- An official English-translated copy must be attached if the transcript is not in English. The interpretation of grades (in English) is also required.
- Degree Certificate/Graduation Certificate/Proof of Study (as appropriate)
- Verification proof by third-party authorities (for a completed programme):
- Online Verification Report of Higher Education Degree Certificate (中國高等教育學位在綫驗証報告), both Chinese and English versions, issued by the CHSI (中國高等教育學生信息網) for qualification(s) awarded by universities in the Chinese Mainland
- Online Query of Overseas Credentials Evaluation Reports國(境)外學歷學位認証書 issued by the Chinese Service Center for Scholarly Exchange (CSCSE) (教育部留學服務中心) (applicable to applicants from the Chinese Mainland with qualifications awarded by overseas universities)
- Proof of English language proficiency, e.g. IETLS, TOEFL, CET-6 Score Report (applicable to applicants whose degree, or exceptionally, an alternative qualification deemed equivalent, was not awarded by a tertiary institution where English was used as the MOI for the degree programme)
- Personal statement
- Reference letters (if any)
*Do not upload copy of HKID. Local students will be required to present HKID for verification upon registration.*
Applicants may be required to submit a Report for Qualifications Assessment issued by the Hong Kong Council for Accreditation of Academic & Vocational Qualifications (HKCAAVQ) to support their application.

Interview Requirements.content: Interviews may be conducted if deemed necessary by the Admissions Coordinator and the Programme Director. Interviews will be used to verify the motivation and competence of the applicants, especially for applicants with degrees not directly relevant to the programme. In all cases, applicants must meet the minimum admission requirements.

Academic Requirements.content:
- Candidates to be admitted to the SEA programme should normally **hold a relevant bachelor's degree or other related certification awarded by a tertiary education institution as recognised for admission purposes by LU**; or **have equivalent qualifications and experience**, considered on a case-by-case basis.
- Candidates should **master basic computing knowledge**, and **basic understanding of data analysis preferred**.
- In all cases, applicants must meet the minimum admission requirements.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
Candidates to be admitted to the SEA programme should normally meet the English language proficiency requirement* (for applicants whose degree or, exceptionally, an alternative qualification deemed equivalent from a tertiary institution is not using English as the medium of instruction (MOI) for the programme should obtain:
1. **a minimum score of 79 (internet-based test)** in the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) [**iBT Home Edition/IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted**];
2. **band score of 6.0 or above** in the International English Language Testing System (IELTS); or
3. equivalent score in a recognised test, or an equivalent qualification to prove the English language proficiency (considered on a case-by case basis).
*Subject to the Senate’s approval.*
For IELTS and TOEFL qualifications for admission purpose, the University only accepts results of tests that are conducted at a test centre and within the validity period, viz. **2 years**, from the time of submission of an admission application for the specific intake cohort.

Program Overview.content:
**Unleashing the Power of Data Analytics in Sustainable World: Introducing the Master of Science in Sustainability and Environmental Analytics**
The Master of Science in Sustainability and Environmental Analytics (SEA) programme offered by Lingnan University's Science Unit (SU) is a response to the growing demand for sustainable development and environmental management in the 21st century. The programme is designed to equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge to address the challenges of sustainable development and environmental management and prepare them for the complex challenges they will encounter in their careers.
What sets SEA apart is its focus on data analytics to assist sustainable transformation and achieve the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The programme is centred around the SDGs, addressing a majority of them, including affordable and clean energy (SDG7), sustainable cities and communities (SDG11), and climate action (SDG13), and among others. Students will learn about strategies for analysing environmental data and designing effective sustainability plans, gaining a deep understanding of the social, economic, and environmental factors that influence sustainable development.
Data analytics is also a key tool for implementing Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) Planning, which is a core component of the programme. SEA students will learn how to use data analytics to evaluate and improve the ESG performance of organisations and projects, as well as to communicate their ESG impacts to stakeholders and tackle the ESG challenges.
SEA is developed in collaboration with renowned industry partners, ensuring that the programme meets future industry needs while prioritizing sustainable growth. SEA students will gain hands-on experience in applying their knowledge to real-world environmental and sustainability problems through field trips led by NGOs and/or experts in the field, as well as through research training and internship opportunities. These experiential learning deepens students' understanding of the concepts and theories taught in the programme, improve their experiences and skills in tackling global and local real-world problems, and more importantly enhance their up-to-date understanding of the job market.

Cost of Attendance.content:
It is recommended that students prepare a budget of HK$6,200 - $7,500 to cover their first month's expenses.
The estimated monthly expenses may vary depending on individual lifestyle and spending habits. The following table is provided for general reference only:
| Item | Approx. expenses per month (HKD) |
| --- | --- |
| Meals (on campus) | HK$4,500 - $5,000 |
| Entertainment | HK$600 - $700 |
| Transportation (local) | HK$600 - $800 |
| Miscellaneous | HK$500 - $1,000 |
| **Total** | **HK$6,200 - $7,500** |

Financial Aid.content:
Scholarships will be considered for outstanding students on the basis of academic merit and extracurricular excellence. A range of entrance scholarships are available to support high-calibre MScSEA international students, including those from low and lower-middle income countries.
- [Outstanding Student Award (Grand Award)](https://www.ln.edu.hk/dos/sea/#collapse-0): Scholarship HKD 10,000; a 3-month trainee contract (Participating organizations: Division of Science of Hong Kong Lingnan University and Labway Biotechnology Limited); recognition certificate and trophy will also be presented. Eligibility includes achieved overall GPA of 3.0 or above in Term 1, 2025-26 with a minimum CGPA of 3.00 in Term 2 2025-26; highly participated in extracurricular activities, and eager to contribute the community and explore career path in Hong Kong. Complete the [application form](https://lingnan.asia.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_0Ak2Rhj7pdwtAQS) by **30 April 2026** with required supporting documents.
- [Outstanding Achievement in Academic Excellence](https://www.ln.edu.hk/dos/sea/#collapse-1): Scholarship HKD 8,000; recognition certificate will also be presented. Eligibility includes achieved overall GPA of 3.2 or above in Term 1 2025-26 with a minimum CGPA of 3.00 in Term 2 2025-26, regular attendance and high participation throughout the whole academic year. Top 5 outstanding candidates will be nominated by Division of Science to compete for the Award; if candidates have comparable academic merits, priority shall be given to the student who has financial needs.
- [Outstanding Achievement in Extracurricular Excellence](https://www.ln.edu.hk/dos/sea/#collapse-2): Scholarship HKD 5,000; recognition certificate will also be presented. Eligibility includes high participation in extracurricular activities, and willingness to contribute the community. Top 5 outstanding candidates will be nominated by Division of Science to compete for the Award; if candidates have comparable extracurricular performance, priority shall be given to the student who has financial needs.

Multiple Applications.content: You are required to submit separate applications if you wish to make multiple applications for different programmes of our School. Please also note that multiple application fees should be paid. Your chance of success will not be affected. However, applicants are not encouraged to switch to another programme once an admission offer has been accepted. Please be aware that the deposit fee will not be refunded if you decide to switch to another programme.

Deferral Admission Policy.content:
An applicant who has been offered admission to an approved programme of study is required to register with the Programme Office on a specified date and is considered to have been admitted to such programme on the date of his/her first registration. Registration includes payment of the fees due and enrolment and selection of courses/sections. An applicant who fails to pay the prescribed fees or register on the relevant specified dates is considered as having forgone his/her place offered by the University.
A student who for special reasons seeks permission for deferment of his/her registration may apply in writing to the Programme Director **at least one week before the specified date for registration**. A fee for late registration will be charged by the Programme Office.
